description: Andhra Pradesh will establish India’s first AI University in Amaravati, partnering with NVIDIA, to enhance education and governance.
body_lead: The Andhra Pradesh State government will establish India’s first dedicated Artificial Intelligence (AI) University in Amaravati in partnership with NVIDIA, announced A.P. ITE&C Department Secretary Katamaneni Bhaskhar on Wednesday. Attending as chief guest at the TechBharat AI for Public Good summit held at GITAM Deemed-to-be University, Mr. Bhaskar distributed fellowships to students. He announced that the AI University will commence operations from February 19, 2026.
